children: Generation received a Nasdaq panel exception extending its deadline to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price to November 18, 2026.
Nasdaq notified Generation it was noncompliant with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2).
The company requested a hearing, which stayed any suspension or delisting while the Panel considered the case.
The Nasdaq Hearings Panel granted an exception extending the compliance deadline to Nov. 18, 2026.
Generation intends to seek a further discretionary extension if it cannot regain compliance by that date.
